verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents in-product AI assistance. Composer takes a goal and builds the audience, drafts content and maps a send strategy for your review ([klaviyo-docs-25], [klaviyo-docs-37]). The pricing page lists "Get answers from your data" ([klaviyo-docs-50]), and there is an AI subject-line generator ([klaviyo-docs-20]) and K:AI channel optimization ([klaviyo-docs-36]). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of in-product analytical insights (the "answers from your data" capability is a one-line mention), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of the AI insights.
